fieldValues.boundary_clause: Expression can be added as a layer. Pure integrity means never changing. We ideally allow expression to be built on top of the core, but this will sometimes require additional elements to build on. We can add expressiveness to core as long as we have found it to be the simplest option possible, and our data does not cross layers. Meaning should always reside at the meaning layer.
fieldValues.context: Applied by default in the Versioning and Reference trade-off of the semantic-records charter.
